name: HeroUI (formerly NextUI), v3 current + v2 legacy plugin
licence: Apache-2.0 (github.com/heroui-inc/heroui). Studied v3 @heroui/styles 3.2.6 at commit 83b92df (2026-10-08) and the v2 branch (@heroui/theme 2.4.9 tag line, plugin.ts, default-layout.ts, colors/*.ts).
bestFor: consumer-facing SaaS dashboards, settings and onboarding flows where a soft, rounded, friendly look is wanted
projects already on Tailwind CSS v4 + React 19 + React Aria that want accessible components with CSS-variable theming
teams that want to retheme with 5-10 CSS variables (accent, radius, surface, background) via the Theme Builder
avoidFor: dense data-heavy admin UIs (large radii, 36-44px controls, generous padding)
editorial or high-contrast brutalist brands (default is soft pill radii and low-chroma greys)
non-React stacks, although the CSS layer is usable with plain HTML via BEM classes

families: v3: no font defined by the theme; inherits Tailwind v4 defaults (sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, emoji stack; mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, Liberation Mono, Courier New, monospace). Kbd sets font-sans explicitly.
v2: the plugin theme object defines fontSize and lineHeight layout tokens only; no font family is set (unknown which font the v2 docs use)

scale.role: button / label / tab / select (default control text)

typography.notes: v3 has no type scale of its own; sizes come from Tailwind v4 text-xs..text-4xl (line-heights 16/20/24/28/28/32/36/40 px). Component text is almost always text-sm font-medium (14px/500); inputs are text-base (16px) below the sm breakpoint and text-sm from sm up (prevents iOS zoom). Only the optional .typography-prose class defines headings: semibold with tracking-tight (-0.025em) at every level. v2 layout tokens: fontSize tiny 0.75rem, small 0.875rem, medium 1rem, large 1.125rem; lineHeight tiny 1rem, small 1.25rem, medium 1.5rem, large 1.75rem. No weight or tracking tokens in either version.

neutrals.note: v3 neutrals are zinc-like: hue 286, chroma 0.001-0.015. Hex values below are this study's oklch->sRGB conversions (approximate, +/-1).

accents.note: v3 has no numbered ramps: ONE value per role (accent, success, warning, danger) and everything else is derived with color-mix. v2 had 9-step ramps (below).

v3 surfaces: surface (cards, accordions), overlay (tooltips, popovers, modals, menus)
separator, separator-secondary (85/15 of surface/fg), separator-tertiary (81/19), border-secondary (78/22), border-tertiary (66/34)
focus = accent, link = foreground, segment (selected tab pill)
semantic.v2: background #FFFFFF | #000000; foreground #11181C | #ECEDEE; divider rgba(17,17,17,.15) | rgba(255,255,255,.15); focus #006FEE; overlay #000; content1-4 layers (light: #FFFFFF, zinc100, zinc200, zinc300; dark: zinc900, 800, 700, 600) each with a foreground

color.darkMode: v3: class or data-theme (.dark / [data-theme=dark]) re-declares the same variable names; derived colours (hover, soft, borders) are color-mix expressions that recompute automatically. Surface logic differs per mode: light cards cast a 3-layer shadow and sit on a grey page (#f5f5f5) as white; dark cards get no shadow (0 0 0 0 transparent inset) and overlay shadow becomes a 1px inset light edge (rgba(255,255,255,.3)). Soft tint opacity drops from 15% to 12% and soft-foreground mixes shift for dark. Optional data-vibrant-palette=true raises soft-foreground saturation (92/8 mix). v2: separate light and dark colour objects; dark swaps each 50-900 ramp (swapColorValues reverses it) and picks foreground via readableColor from color2k; opacity-based hover (0.8 light / 0.9 dark).
color.contrastNotes: Measured on this study's hex conversions (+/-0.05): v3 accent vs snow foreground 3.59:1 and danger vs snow 3.48:1 (both below 4.5:1 for 14px/500 labels), success vs eclipse 8.08:1 and warning vs eclipse 8.68:1 (dark foregrounds on the lighter fills), muted on page background 4.43:1 (just under 4.5) and on white 4.83:1, dark muted on dark background 7.72:1. v2: primary #006FEE vs white 4.66:1; success #17c964 vs black 9.58:1; warning #f5a524 vs black 10.29:1. Soft chips use accent-soft-foreground = accent mixed 70% with the foreground, which pushes contrast above the plain accent. Disabled is opacity 0.5 on everything (not a contrast-checked colour).

spacing.base: 0.25rem (4px) via Tailwind v4 --spacing: 0.25rem; Tailwind numeric utilities (p-4 = 16px). v2 adds no spacing tokens.

radius.rule: v3: a single base --radius: 0.5rem (8px); every radius token is a multiple (xs 0.25x, sm 0.5x, md 0.75x, lg 1x, xl 1.5x, 2xl 2x, 3xl 3x, 4xl 4x) and --radius-field = 1.5x. Changing --radius rescales the whole system. Defaults are large: Button rounded-3xl (24px, full pill at 36-44px heights), Tabs and tab indicator rounded-3xl, Chip rounded-2xl (16px), Card min(32px, radius-3xl = 24px), Input/Select rounded-field (12px), Checkbox rounded-md (6px), Badge 24px (md), 16px (lg), 12px (sm). v2: radius small 8px, medium 12px, large 14px.

shadows: v3 surface (light): 0 2px 4px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.04), 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.06), 0 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.06); dark: none
v3 overlay (light): 0 2px 8px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.06), 0 -6px 12px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.03), 0 14px 28px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.08); dark: 0 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.3) inset
v3 field (light): same as surface; dark: transparent inset (so ring utilities work)
v2 dark: same recipes with inset 0 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255/.15) edge
depth.borders: v3: --border-width 1px; --field-border-width 0px (form fields are borderless by default and rely on a tinted fill plus soft shadow; border appears on hover/focus via color-mix). Outline button 1px solid --border. v2: border widths small 1px, medium 2px, large 3px, divider weight 1px.
depth.blur: No blur tokens. Backdrops are flat rgba (0.5 light, 0.6 dark). Skeleton shimmer and Button loading are the only motion-blur-like effects.

easings: full Penner-style set (in/out/in-out x quad, cubic, quart, quint, expo, circ)
motion.notes: Frequency of literals across component CSS: 150ms x95, 100ms x33, 250ms x23, 200ms x21, 300ms x4, 350ms x3. Button: transform 250ms ease, background 100ms ease-out, box-shadow 100ms; pressed state scale(0.97) (md), 0.98 (sm), 0.96 (lg). Inputs: 150ms ease for background/border, 150ms ease-out for shadow. Tabs indicator slides translate/width/height over 250ms. Tooltip opens after 1500ms delay and closes after 500ms (variables --tooltip-delay, --tooltip-close-delay). Every transition is followed by motion-reduce:transition-none, and the custom motion-reduce variant honours data-reduce-motion=true before prefers-reduced-motion (reduced motion is built in). v3 replaced v2's Framer Motion with CSS + GPU transforms. :hover styles are wrapped in @media (hover:hover).

modes: touch-vs-pointer responsive height (controls are 4px taller below the md breakpoint)

controlHeightsPx.button padding-x: px-4 (16px) md; px-3 (12px) sm; lg keeps md padding
controlHeightsPx.Input / TextField height: derived: py-2 (8+8) + line-height; 36 (text-sm 20px line) from sm breakpoint, 40 below (text-base 24px)
controlHeightsPx.Chip (sm, md, lg): py-0 / py-0.5 / py-1 around 16-20px line, text 12 / 12 / 14

components.stateMatrixCompleteness: Strong, uniform state model through Tailwind utilities + data attributes. Button variants (semantic hierarchy): primary, secondary, tertiary, ghost, outline, danger, danger-soft; sizes sm, md, lg (+ icon-only, full-width); states: hover (only @media hover:hover, via --button-bg-hover), pressed (scale .96-.98 plus --button-bg-pressed), focus-visible (ring 2px focus colour with 2px background-coloured offset), disabled (opacity .5, cursor not-allowed, pointer-events none), pending (pointer-events none). Chip: variants primary, secondary, tertiary x colours accent, success, warning, danger, default x soft modifier x sizes sm, md, lg. Inputs: variants primary, secondary; states hover, focus (ring 2px with 0 offset), invalid (1px danger outline then 2px ring on focus), disabled. All behaviour hooks are React Aria data attributes (data-hovered, data-pressed, data-focused, data-focus-visible, data-disabled, data-invalid, data-pending). Compound variants are written as joined class selectors (.chip--primary.chip--accent). Missing: no explicit loading-state spec for Input, no density modes.

tokenArchitecture: v3 (current): pure CSS on Tailwind v4. Cascade layers `theme, base, components, utilities`. Primitive colours (--white, --black, --snow, --eclipse) -> role colours (--background, --foreground, --surface, --overlay, --accent, --success, --warning, --danger, --default, --muted, --border, --separator, --focus, --link, --segment, --field-*) -> calculated colours via color-mix (hover, soft, secondary/tertiary levels) -> @theme inline mapping to Tailwind tokens (--color-accent etc., --radius-*, --shadow-surface/overlay/field, --ease-*). Naming rule: no suffix = background, -foreground = text on it, -hover, -soft, -soft-foreground, -soft-hover. Component styling uses BEM classes (.button, .button--primary, .card__header, .chip--primary.chip--accent) that only set component-scoped custom properties (--button-bg, --button-bg-hover, --button-fg, --chip-bg ...); utilities status-focused, status-disabled, status-invalid-field, touch-target provide shared state. Styles are separate from logic (@heroui/styles vs @heroui/react) so plain HTML can use the classes. Themes are CSS blocks keyed by [data-theme=name]; the Theme Builder exports CSS. v2 (legacy): a Tailwind plugin `heroui({themes:{light:{colors,layout},dark:{...}}, defaultTheme, defaultExtendTheme})` generating HSL-channel CSS variables `--heroui-{color}-{shade}` and layout variables `--heroui-radius-small`, `--heroui-box-shadow-medium`, `--heroui-hover-opacity`, `--heroui-disabled-opacity`, `--heroui-divider-weight`; colours are a semantic object (default, primary, secondary, success, warning, danger, each 50-900 + DEFAULT + foreground) with content1-4, background, foreground, divider, focus, overlay; variants via tailwind-variants (visual names such as solid, bordered, flat per the v3 migration comparison table; full list not re-verified in this pass).
distinctiveness: Soft, rounded, 'app-store' look: pill buttons and tabs (24px radius), borderless filled form fields on a light-grey (#f5f5f5) page with white cards, very light diffused shadows, zinc greys, a single clear blue accent, and press-scale feedback on buttons. The recognisable system idea is semantic intent (primary / secondary / tertiary) replacing visual names, and a minimal colour model: one value per role with all hover/soft/border states derived by color-mix.
weaknesses: Accent (3.59:1) and danger (3.48:1) with their snow foreground fall below 4.5:1 for 14px/500 labels; muted text is 4.43:1 on the default page background
No type scale, no font, no weight tokens: typography is inherited from Tailwind defaults
Pill radii and 36-44px controls reduce density; not suited to data-dense UIs
Tooltip delay of 1500ms feels slow for power users
Disabled via opacity 0.5 only (no separate disabled colours), hover only on hover-capable devices (good) but no pressed-state colour distinct from hover (pressed = hover colour + scale)
v3 is young and v2 (hex/HSL ramps, content1-4, plugin) is a different system; ecosystem docs and examples mix both
Tint ramps (50-900) were removed in v3, so arbitrary tinted surfaces must be built with color-mix
takeaways: Name variants by semantic intent and usage limits (primary: one per context; secondary: several; tertiary: dismissive; danger: destructive) instead of by visual style.
Define one value per colour role and DERIVE hover, soft backgrounds, soft foregrounds and border levels with color-mix in oklab; changing --accent re-themes everything.
Use a clear suffix grammar for colour tokens: base = background, -foreground = text on it, -hover, -soft, -soft-foreground.

Separate surface (in-flow containers) from overlay (floating layers) tokens, each with its own foreground and its own shadow; remove surface shadow in dark mode and use a 1px inset light edge on overlays.
Drive the entire radius scale from one base value with multipliers, plus a distinct field radius (1.5x) so inputs can differ from cards.
Make form fields borderless-by-default with a --field-border-width token and derive hover/focus border colours by mixing toward the field foreground (88/10 hover, 74/22 focus).
Make touch targets 4px taller under the md breakpoint (36/40/44 vs 32/36/40) and keep hover styles inside @media (hover:hover).
Treat reduced motion as a built-in variant (data-reduce-motion first, prefers-reduced-motion fallback), with motion-reduce placed after transition for specificity.
Press feedback scales with control size (0.98 / 0.97 / 0.96), a small rule that makes bigger buttons feel equally weighty.
